dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge spline with a sharp curvature inward between the apex and the dorsal ridge insertion point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a moderate pixel radius, classified as obtuse rather than acute.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree anterior slope relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the visible torso.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Ratio of maximum base width to maximum vertical height is approximately 0.85:1, indicating a taller than wide profile.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad, shallow convex arc extending from the dorsal cranium to the rostral base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, blunt beak with a pixel length roughly equal to its vertical thickness at the inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse angle approximately 150 degrees at the pixel transition from the melon slope to the dorsal rostrum margin.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast bicolored pigmentation pattern featuring a dark dorsal field transitioning into a bright white-to-gray lateral flank swoop.
